verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const f="app/(main)/events/[slug]/event-member-page.tsx";if(!fs.existsSync(f))process.exit(79);const s=fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8");const selected=/\.select\(\s*[\x27"][^\x27"]*\bremoved_at\b[^\x27"]*[\x27"]/.test(s);const gated=/if\s*\([^)]*removed_at[^)]*\)\s*notFound\(\)/.test(s);if(!selected||!gated){console.error("SCAN-699: the member event page still neither selects removed_at nor gates on it, so a staff-removed event renders in full for every signed-in member.");process.exit(1)}'

append.detail: The member event page read the events row with the admin client through a select that omitted removed_at and had no removal gate, so a public event staff had removed for spam or abuse (reportRemoveEvent stamps removed_at and is_cancelled but leaves status published and visibility untouched) passed the draft and visibility gates and rendered in full under a Cancelled chip for every signed-in member who followed the link, while anonymous readers already got a 404 and a blank OG card. Fix in app/(main)/events/[slug]/event-member-page.tsx: removed_at is now on the one single-quoted events select and on ExtraMeta, and 'if (extra?.removed_at && !canManage) notFound()' sits next to the draft guard, so only a manager (host or staff) can still open a removed event; generateMetadata also reads removed_at and returns an 'Event not found' noindexed head for one. Pinned by a new describe in app/(main)/events/[slug]/read-fanout.test.ts that reads the select, the gate order (draft, removal, visibility) and the metadata branch; read-fanout, claim-wiring and check-event-hero-parity all pass.
